title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Sorter
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Sorter. Device that performs the task of sorting. Subclass of s4envi:WastePreTreatmentDevice (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.11); all WasteProcessingDevice attributes are inherited (via WastePreTreatmentDevice), not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Sorter'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
